<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600;700&family=Noto+Serif+TC:wght@600;700&family=Noto+Sans+TC:wght@400;500;700&family=Noto+Sans+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap">
<style>
/* NeptusHydro v2: chrome injected site-wide, code-block pages start with .nh-page, blog uses native posts */
#header, header#header { display: none !important; }
#footer-sections { display: none !important; }
html, body, #siteWrapper { background: #FBF8F1 !important; }
.nh-chrome { font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
.nh-chrome, .nh-chrome * { box-sizing: content-box; }
.nh-chrome h2, .nh-chrome p { letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; }
.nh-chrome a:not([style*="color"]) { color: #F1E9D6 !important; }
.nh-chrome :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F2A541; outline-offset: 3px; }
section.page-section:has(.nh-page) { padding: 0 !important; min-height: 0 !important; }
section.page-section:has(.nh-page) .content-wrapper { padding: 0 !important; max-width: none !important; width: 100% !important; }
section.page-section:has(.nh-page) .content { width: 100% !important; }
section.page-section:has(.nh-page) .fluid-engine { display: block !important; }
section.page-section:has(.nh-page) .fe-block { width: 100% !important; }
.sqs-block:has(.nh-page), .sqs-block:has(.nh-page) > .sqs-block-content { padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
.nh-page, .nh-page * { box-sizing: content-box; }
.nh-page { -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
.nh-page h1, .nh-page h2, .nh-page h3, .nh-page p, .nh-page li { letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; }
.nh-page a:not([style*="color"]), .nh-post a:not([style*="color"]) { color: #1A4682 !important; }
.nh-page a:not([style*="color"]):hover, .nh-post a:not([style*="color"]):hover { color: #0F3D6B !important; }
.nh-page :focus-visible, .nh-post :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A4682; outline-offset: 3px; }
.nh-page [data-theme="dark"] :focus-visible { outline-color: #F2A541; }
.nh-page article li::marker, .nh-post li::marker { color: #8E5A14; }
.nh-page [data-nh-list] > a:hover h3 { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
.nh-logo { background: url("data:image/webp;base64,") center / contain no-repeat; }

/* ---- blog list page: native list hidden, NeptusHydro list drawn instead */
html.nh-has-bloglist .blog-list-section,
html.nh-has-bloglist section.collection-content-wrapper,
html.nh-has-bloglist .blog-basic-grid, html.nh-has-bloglist .blog-side-by-side-wrapper,
html.nh-has-bloglist .blog-single-column, html.nh-has-bloglist .blog-alternating-side-by-side-wrapper,
html.nh-has-bloglist .blog-masonry { display: none !important; }
html.nh-has-bloglist #sections > section.page-section { display: none !important; }

/* ---- blog post page (native) */
body[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-meta-item--author, body[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-author,
body[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-author-profile-wrapper, body[class*="collection-type-blog"] .author-profile { display: none !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-meta-item--date::after, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-meta-item--date::before { content: none !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-category-wrapper::after { content: "\00B7" !important; margin: 0 6px; color: #0B7068; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-category-wrapper:last-child::after { content: none !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-meta-wrapper { gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] #page { background: #FBF8F1; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-wrapper,
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] article.entry { max-width: 1080px !important; margin-left: auto !important; margin-right: auto !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] section.blog-item-wrapper, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-wrapper { padding-left: 24px; padding-right: 24px; }
.nh-back { display: inline-block; margin: 0 0 24px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1A4682 !important; text-decoration: none; }
.nh-back:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-title h1,
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] h1.entry-title,
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] h1.blog-title { font-family: 'Noto Serif TC', 'Songti TC', serif !important; font-size: 40px !important; line-height: 1.35 !important; font-weight: 700 !important; color: #0F3D6B !important; letter-spacing: normal !important; text-transform: none !important; text-wrap: balance; text-align: left !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-meta-section, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-meta-wrapper,
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-meta-item { font-family: 'Noto Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace !important; font-size: 14px !important; color: #4A5B70 !important; letter-spacing: normal !important; text-transform: none !important; justify-content: flex-start !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-meta-item--categories a, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-categories a { font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif !important; color: #0B7068 !important; font-weight: 500 !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content,
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content p,
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content li { font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif !important; font-size: 16px !important; line-height: 1.75 !important; color: #06172E !important; letter-spacing: normal !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content h1,
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content h2 { margin: 48px 0 20px !important; padding-top: 40px; border-top: 1px solid #CDBF9E; font-family: 'Noto Serif TC', 'Songti TC', serif !important; font-size: 30px !important; line-height: 1.35 !important; font-weight: 700 !important; color: #0F3D6B !important; letter-spacing: normal !important; text-transform: none !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content h3 { margin: 32px 0 12px !important; font-family: 'Noto Serif TC', 'Songti TC', serif !important; font-size: 22px !important; line-height: 1.45 !important; font-weight: 700 !important; color: #0F3D6B !important; letter-spacing: normal !important; text-transform: none !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content h4 { font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif !important; font-size: 18px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; color: #06172E !important; letter-spacing: normal !important; text-transform: none !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content a { color: #1A4682 !important; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content li::marker { color: #8E5A14; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content blockquote { margin: 24px 0 !important; padding: 4px 0 4px 20px !important; border-left: 3px solid #F2A541; color: #4A5B70 !important; font-style: normal !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content code { font-family: 'Noto Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.92em; background: #F1E9D6; border: 1px solid #CDBF9E; border-radius: 2px; padding: 1px 5px; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content pre { background: #06172E; color: #F1E9D6; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px 20px; overflow-x: auto; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content pre code { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; color: inherit; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 15px; margin: 8px 0 24px; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content th, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content td { border-top: 1px solid #CDBF9E; padding: 12px 14px; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content thead th { background: #F1E9D6; color: #0F3D6B; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content img { border-radius: 4px; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content .image-caption p, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content figcaption { font-size: 14px !important; color: #4A5B70 !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .sqs-block:has(.nh-post) { padding-left: 0 !important; padding-right: 0 !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-pagination, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .item-pagination { max-width: 1080px; margin: 40px auto 72px !important; padding: 24px 24px 0 !important; border-top: 1px solid #CDBF9E; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .item-pagination a, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-pagination a { color: #1A4682 !important; }
body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .item-pagination-title, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .pagination-title-wrapper h2 { font-family: 'Noto Serif TC', 'Songti TC', serif !important; font-size: 18px !important; color: #0F3D6B !important; letter-spacing: normal !important; text-transform: none !important; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-title h1, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] h1.entry-title, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] h1.blog-title { font-size: 30px !important; }
  body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content h1, body.view-item[class*="collection-type-blog"] .blog-item-content h2 { font-size: 25px !important; }

</style>
